headline: Weathered Expanse Reignites as Mooring and Callum's Cape Suffer Heavy Toll
war_summary: Weathered Expanse has flared back to life with furious intensity, registering thirteen strategic base shifts over the past two hours amidst contested ground at Crow's Nest and Wightwalk. Mooring County endures as a relentless meat grinder, logging nine further base turnovers in the same span alongside nearly thirty-four hundred combined casualties. In Callum's Cape, combat has reached a fever pitch; casualty rates have accelerated dramatically to over two thousand fallen in two hours as fresh enlistments surge into the fray around Lookout and Naofa. Linn of Mercy maintains an active tempo with eight recent base changes, though bloodletting has slackened compared to neighboring sectors. Elsewhere along the front, comparative quiet prevails; Marban Hollow, Dead Lands, and Stonecradle report no base exchanges during the latest watch, leaving the war's decisive maneuvers concentrated along the northern and central axes.
